meaning: One codebase tracked in revision control; many deploys
Explicitly declare and isolate dependencies (requirements.txt + venv)
Store config in the environment (.env / env vars)
Treat databases and APIs as attached resources (swap by changing config)
Strictly separate build and run stages
Run the app as one or more stateless processes
Scale out via the process model
Keep development staging and production as similar as possible
Treat logs as event streams (write to stdout)
Run admin/management tasks as one-off processes (e.g. a db init script)
